diagnostics.interpretation: Both section methods and historical trial flags remain preserved. No physical margin or whole-joint pass follows.

diameter_roles.geometry: Edge/end/row markers use nominal major D. Never reduce geometry distances using Dr.
diameter_roles.stiffness: Issued nominal-diameter shaft and foundation assumptions remain unchanged; physical stiffness is uncalibrated.
diameter_roles.wood_pressure: 54 of the 88 new two-media axes use conditional Dr; 34 satisfy the quarter-thread exception. This is not the count of all force-only yield-mode diameter selections.
diameter_roles.yield_modes: Existing frozen TR12 helper already selects body D or thread-root Dr using recorded thread overlap. No nominal-D bug was established.

force_only_coverage: The retained v1/v2 partial census and runnable six wood-only-axis extension remain conditional subchecks. No claim that all 92 two-media force-only rows have been consolidated is made here. Force-only P/Z omits free couples and cannot replace the same-field wrench assessment.

geometry.below_4D_end_category: All plywood; sawn-member rules are not automatically applicable.
geometry.center_principal_correction: 068/069 act net away in all six cases. Their 33.704295 mm near-edge distance versus 38.1 mm both-edge marker is optional conservatism, not an established NDS violation. Oblique/eccentric/splitting checks remain open.
geometry.classifications: Signed actions, actual end shapes, plywood rules and row ownership remain necessary. Marker counts are not counts of established code violations.
geometry.header_known_answers: All 12 full-profile controls match; nearest edge 38.45 mm, nominal marker margin 0.35 mm. Entry/exit faces are not wood edges.
geometry.side_correction: 067 is net away in five cases, but toward by about 2.548 N in a1-rear; do not extend the 068/069 conclusion to all cleat axes.

material_threshold_interpretation: Each pressure field is statically admissible for its signed forces and couples; it is not a qualified observed embedment distribution. Different valid field choices can give different sufficient material thresholds. These thresholds are not necessary physical capacities. The extra VM/divisor-5 parameter is a declared reference, not a derived complete NDS group interaction or interchangeable Fy. Existing affine-pressure diagnostics remain preserved.

rear_strength_option_only.declared_reference: Additional conservative elastic Fy/5 sensitivity, not an adopted code design value and not Fyb.
rear_strength_option_only.interpretation: Same-diameter higher grade is an unadopted strength-only scenario. It does not establish Fyb, product identity, fit, group/splitting or full connection acceptance.

remaining: Qualify a simultaneous force-and-moment capacity or conservative wrench envelope for actual oblique actions, unequal media and shared fitting paths. Sufficient material-reference thresholds are not a complete NDS interaction solution.
Establish physical row/group ownership, effective member/fitting EA and compatible slip redistribution; actual Cg and Cdelta remain null.
Resolve loaded edge/end/spacing and top-grid applicability, local splitting and eccentric tension perpendicular to grain without treating every conservative marker as a violation.
Complete formed-fitting/plate local resistance, loaded-hole behavior, axial head/nut transfer and delivered body/thread/grip/washer/spacer/access checks.
Record delivered timber species/grade/moisture/dimensions; plywood grade/axis/minimum thickness, adhesive/bond evidence and real support/contact assumptions. Custom solid packers remain unapproved.
Panel screw resistance remains deferred by owner. No floor-friction test or blanket new external sign-off prerequisite is added.
retention: Large raw reports, current force fields and their source-bound producers stay active in the existing ignored packet. Public compact evidence is additive; original inputs, historical probes and frozen reports are unchanged.

full_696_axis_case_criterion_coverage.criterion_status: conditional per-axis material/section thresholds are available for every applicable medium; actual material strengths and complete group/wrench criteria remain unresolved

same_field_criterion_scope.reason_remaining: Current selected body/root dimensions are analytical scenarios; delivered material strengths are absent, the group factors remain unresolved, and the calculated per-axis material/section thresholds do not define complete simultaneous wrench capacities.

scope: Current-bank postprocessing only. No geometry, stiffness, global force case, external load, or adopted factor changed. Required reference properties and conditional scenarios are not measured capacities or full connection acceptance.

slip_coupon.interpretation: 20 rigid-host, zero-gap, free-shaft translation coupons. Variational series-foundation upper bounds and known-answer controls do not demonstrate NDS-equivalent calibrated serial-row redistribution. These are not actual stiffnesses, capacity factors or force amplification factors. Neither complete double counting nor no overlap is established.

top_grid.applicability: Actual oblique/nonuniform moment actions and steel-only-side interpretation of the wood-length footnote remain unresolved. No verified angular interpolation or Cdelta waiver adopted.
top_grid.option_only: An alternative qualified factory pattern with grain pitch at least 47.625 mm could address this endpoint; 50.8 mm provides 3.175 mm nominal margin. Translation does not change internal pitch. No redrilling, pattern selection or redesign is adopted.

washer.scope: Exact modeled annular footprints and saved load-only axial reactions; Cb=1, no CD or Cg. Excludes steel and plywood. Real preload, pressure peaks, washer rigidity/fit and pull-through remain unqualified.
